feeds.title: My Pet Chicken Blog
feeds.description: The My Pet Chicken Blog features posts from several chicken keepers to help people learn about raising backyard chickens. It's easy and rewarding to keep backyard chickens, and we can supply everything you need to get started including baby chicks, chicken coops, accessories, books, and free 'how-to' information, plus fun gifts and rooster decor.

feeds.title: Cackle Hatchery » Chicken Care
feeds.description: Find articles on taking care of your chicken flock, diseases, keeping the predators out, and more! Chicken Hatchery specializes in hatching and shipping newly hatched pure-bred poultry to your local post office since 1936.

feeds.title: Randy's Chicken Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Randy and this is my chicken blog. I write it, edit it, take pictures, feed the chickens, hug the chickens, etc. I blog about chickens, chicken behavior, chicken diseases, chicken coops, chicken equipment, chicken books, and basically, how cool chickens really are!

feeds.title: Easy Chicken Recipes Blog
feeds.description: Here on Easy Chicken Recipes, you'll find SIMPLE recipes, everything from dinners to brunch. I strive to keep cooking engaging and delicious, while fast and easy. If you're wanting to learn how to cook, or just want some quick meals to have in your back pocket, this is the place for you.

feeds.title: Skinny Taste » Chicken Recipes
feeds.description: There are so many delicious chicken recipes out there, but these are some of the best tasting, healthiest ones you will find! Hi, I'm Gina Homolka, author and recipe developer of Skinnytaste.com which features delicious, healthy, family-friendly recipes made with real food.

feeds.title: Kristine's Kitchen » Chicken Recipes
feeds.description: Delicious, flavorful meals made with chicken. Kristine's Kitchen is here to help you cook meals that are nutritious, delicious, and family-friendly. The recipes found here call for fresh ingredients and simple preparations. Based on lightened-up classics and family favorites, they're designed to be just as satisfying as they are nutritious.

feeds.title: Plain Chicken » Chicken
feeds.description: Quick and easy chicken recipes. Grilled chicken, baked chicken, chicken fingers, chicken casseroles, air-fryer chicken recipes, chicken burgers. Hi, I'm Stephanie Parker, author and recipe developer of PlainChicken.com which features quick and easy recipes made with everyday ingredients.

feeds.title: Emily Bites » Chicken
feeds.description: Find all kinds of chicken recipes from easy 10 minutes to overnight, slow-cooked, salads, and more! Emily Bites is a cooking blog proving that healthy can be delicious by offering lightened-up recipes that never compromise on flavor.

feeds.title: The Magical Slow Cooker » Chicken
feeds.description: Find the best slow cooker chicken recipes for every meal here on The Magical Slow Cooker. You can cook chicken breasts, thighs, or even a whole chicken in the slow cooker. The Magical Slow Cooker is where Sarah shares all her favorite slow cooker recipes.

feeds.title: I am a food blog » Chicken
feeds.description: I am a Food Blog is a recipe & travel blog written by husband and wife team Mike & Steph. In its 7 years of existence, it has covered such diverse subjects as mini beef wellingtons, driving through Iceland's ring road, and making pho in a pressure cooker.

feeds.title: Meyer Hatchery Blog
feeds.description: Blog about incubating, brooding, poultry health & wellness, meat birds, coops & outdoor spaces, chicken, breed spotlight, and homestead. Meyer Hatchery is America's industry-leading hatchery, offering more than 160 breeds of poultry including chickens, ducks, geese, turkeys, guineas, gambirds, and more, as well as a full line of feed, gifts, and supplies.

feeds.title: The Recipe Critic » Chicken Recipes
feeds.description: Looking for your next go-to dinner plan? Browse our selection of easy chicken recipes that taste great! I am Alyssa Rivers and the food blogger behind The Recipe Critic. The blog launched in 2012 as a place to share my passion for cooking. I love trying new things and testing them out with my family. Each recipe is tried and true, family-tested and approved.

feeds.title: Freedom Ranger Hatcheries Blog
feeds.description: Read our blog to know more about chicken behavior, tips, advice for taking care of them, and more! Freedom Ranger Hatchery, Inc. provides high-quality chickens for sale at our certified poultry hatchery.

feeds.title: ThermoWorks » Chicken
feeds.description: Whether you're baking, oven-roasting, smoking, or frying, we've got the correct temperature tips to help you find success in cooking chicken. Thermoworks believes temperature affects your daily life. Because of this, we think that great thermometers can make life better.

feeds.title: Timber Creek Farm » Chicken
feeds.description: Learn everything you need to manage your own chicken flock in this blog with information on chicken farming, feeding, diseases, and more! I'm Janet. Timber Creek Farm is our family farm and we share our stories and information with you through the blog.

feeds.title: Murray McMurray Hatchery Blog » Chickens
feeds.description: Hatchery news, updates, and information on Raising Chickens, taking care of them, and more. At Murray McMurray Hatchery, we provide the highest quality poultry and auxiliary products to our customers and have been a trusted, knowledgeable industry resource for over 100 years.

feeds.title: The Cape Coop » Backyard Chickens
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Liz, welcome to The Cape Coop! I am a New England backyard farmer raising chickens, ducks, rabbits, alpacas, & gardening in my 1-acre yard.

feeds.title: Chicken Method
feeds.description: Learn and understand the basics of raising Chickens. The Chicken Method by Dave Hornbeck provides important resources and advice on Chicken management, and best practices, and also reviews a range of Chicken products for best use.

feeds.title: Backyard Poultry
feeds.description: Read articles on Poultry farming, chicken keeping, backyard coops, and more! Backyard Poultry is the voice of the small flock owner. Backyard Poultry is the voice of the small flock owner. Poultry, gardening, goats, soapmaking, beekeeping and more - we cover all the bases in our magazine.

feeds.title: Beyond The Chicken Coop » Chicken
feeds.description: Delicious chicken recipes for any occasion. From simple dinner to BBQ chicken to one-pan dishes. Perfect for everyday or holidays. Kathy Berget is the author and creator of Beyond the Chicken Coop. She is a busy working mom who loves to cook from scratch, grow a garden, and raise farm animals. Take a look around and find all her recipes, gardening tips, and country living antics.

feeds.title: CoopCrate Chickens Blog
feeds.description: A CoopCrate Backyard Chicken Blog. Coopcrate is the box for backyard chicken keepers. We deliver gourmet treats for chickens, unique gifts for chicken lovers, and more.
